description: Take up to 25 products off sale on Amazon: the offer's quantity becomes 0 (nobody can buy it) — the offer is NOT deleted and keeps its history and reviews in Seller Central — and the product leaves the CRM's Amazon channel so the hourly push does not restore the quantity; adding it to the channel again (set_channel_membership) brings it back. Not gated on the owner's arming (taking an offer down never is), but refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. Returns per product: withdrawn, blocked (noListing, listingNotFound, variationParent), rejected (Amazon's sentences) or failed; notAttempted to call again. The result echoes the workspace.

productIds.description: The products to take off sale, at most 25 ids.
